Task:
Bounded child task for component src/wordstats/topwords (authority: src/wordstats/topwords/as-is.json task object + tasks.md narrative; as-is.md is durable context). Requirement: create src/wordstats/topwords.py implementing the filtering logic behind a future --top N option of wordstats count. It must expose a single pure function keep_top(counts, n) that returns a NEW dict keeping the n most frequent words of the counts mapping, ties broken alphabetically, without mutating the input. No CLI parsing, no I/O, no imports beyond the stdlib, no dependency on other wordstats modules. Scope: edit only src/wordstats/topwords.py and your own record files src/wordstats/topwords/as-is.json and src/wordstats/topwords/tasks.md. Do NOT touch cli.py, counter.py, tests, README, CHANGELOG, or any other file. Do not commit; do not delegate; do not contact external services. Steps: (1) set the task status to active in src/wordstats/topwords/as-is.json (keep all other fields, update 'updated' timestamp); (2) write the module; (3) validate with 'python3 -m compileall -q src' from the repo root and an inline python3 -c behavior check proving: counts {'a':1,'b':3,'c':2} with n=2 keeps b and c, a tie case such as {'x':2,'y':2,'z':1} with n=2 keeps x and y (alphabetical), n=0 returns {}, n larger than the number of words keeps all; (4) record Progress and Validation results in src/wordstats/topwords/tasks.md and set the task status to completed in as-is.json. Acceptance: the acceptance list in the as-is.json task object. Report a concise structured result: finding, evidence paths, recommendation, residual risk.
